facts.fact: UNDP's IDT4M report says the Malawi Social Registry (formerly the Unified Beneficiary Registry) has a dedicated integration module with the NRB, with 3,233,708 of 4,377,763 households (about 74%) linked to a National ID.

UNDP's IDT4M report says NRB generated 1,101,631 QR codes for the Farm Input Subsidy Programme, verified data was uploaded into the FISP application on 12 December 2025, and field testing confirmed readiness for pilot rollout.

note: Report does not say two programmes draw on the registry, nor that it links to civil registration, health, education or tax.
